_instructions: Fixed five-case replay set for rag_index_freshness_gate.py replay. QE fills every slot from a reviewed Jira; the gate refuses (CASE_EXPECTATIONS_UNFILLED) while any slot is empty.
jira_key: the ticket. tenant_id: runtime tenant (default kone). customer / components: the filters the case must not leak across.

decision_text: an exact phrase from the CURRENT Jira decision or accepted UAC. newest_verification_comment: an exact phrase from the newest verification comment. attachment_filename: the applicable attachment, or empty when none applies.

critical_branches: each named state/configuration branch the UAC must cover. terms: exact words that identify the branch in UAC text and evidence. query: retrieval query for the branch. supported: true when the product supports the branch (it must then stay in the UAC or be a TBD even if the customer omitted it). benchmark_critical: true when it needs authoritative evidence in the top five or an explicit TBD.
required_terms: exact AEM/DITA terms (case-sensitive) the UAC must use. requires_negative_contract: true when the UAC must state what is blocked or not allowed.

cases.notes: A change whose behavior must hold, or is decided, separately in the New Editor and the Legacy Editor.
A behavior controlled by a configuration (folder profile, ui_config.json, Workspace setting); both states are named branches.
A change whose outcome must persist after Save and after closing and reopening the document.
Behavior reached through an indirect reference (keyref, conkeyref, conref, or a referenced map).
An action the product must block or refuse; the UAC must state the negative contract explicitly.
